objective: PREFLIGHT READ_ONLY SQL de 130QRO 08/08/2026. Confirmar Runtime V2 autoritativo en 233021.00, 57 tickets y 159 PAX; fallar el check si no coincide.

queries.name: qro_0808_runtime_expected
queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) AS tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) AS pax
  FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-08' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-09'
)
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS ventas_runtime,
       ISNULL(tickets,0) AS tickets_runtime,
       ISNULL(pax,0) AS pax_runtime,
       1 / CASE WHEN ABS(ISNULL(ventas,0)-233021.00)<=0.05
                  AND ISNULL(tickets,0)=57
                  AND ISNULL(pax,0)=159
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gate_pass
FROM r
